description.narrative: The main purpose for this project is for the Danish project group to identify a partner that shares the same goals, vision and ambitions for the partnership. The aim for the partnership is to establish a mentorship programme that mentors young people and children in sensitive situations in the society, with the purpose of giving them resources and competences to be part of the civil society. The chosen destination is Tanzania and hopefully to locate the partnership in Dar Es Salaam. The organisation that would be met with is youth and female empowerment organisations that aim to help children and young people in sensitive situations in society. Tanzania is a compelling destination for development projects for several reasons. Its cultural diversity offers a future opportunity to develop the mentor-program into a mentor-network, which adapts to local nuances. Political stability in Tanzania, relative to some other African regions, adds an element of predictability to the project environment. Additionally, existing infrastructure, encompassing transportation networks, communication facilities, and educational institutions, eases the implementation of development initiatives. Our collaboration with a partner in Tanzania would provide an opportunity for knowledge sharing across borders with recognition of contextual differences. We will enter this journey with a respectful curious mind and an eagerness to learn. TYC shares the democratic values of VU with the promotion of equal rights and youth participation, and we therefore believe that a partnership could yield an impactful project.
